answer.rationale: Compliance forbids rollback of the security patch, so a prior successful rollback is not actionable. The live symptom is write-path p99 at daily settlement peak with heavy writes; that aligns more with adding headroom than with replica-routing of report reads or with fail-fast breakers that would drop customer writes. Regional failover is a weak fit: no regional fault is indicated, and shifting peak settlement traffic risks in-flight writes. Root cause may still be the new build rather than raw capacity, and prior headroom was added before a peak rather than mid-incident, so treat add_capacity as a meaningful but bounded step and do not claim it will fully restore p99.
